sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x060
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:18 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 17:14 ETRSEL[3:0]: etr_in source selection
These bits select the etr_in input source.
0000: tim_etr0: TIMx_ETR input
0001: tim_etr1
...
1111: tim_etr15
Refer to Section54.4.2: TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5 pins and internal signals for product specific
implementation.
Bits 13:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
